description: ODC (C coverage): CALL the consumed REST. Mirrors tests/jobs/rest-consume-call.json and closes the link that was missing in the ODC lane: creating the REST client is useless if nothing calls it. The job creates the client (IRestClient + IRestStructure + IRestAction GET with a parameterized URLPath) and then a server action that INVOKES it with an IExecuteServerActionNode pointed at IRestAction:<Name>, passes the input of the action as the argument of the method and stores a field of the response in an Assign. Platform difference: O11 does the same with base job:rest-consume-get; here the job is standalone over the InsuranceApp fixture and everything is born with the Wf prefix so as not to collide with the real app of the fixture.

expectedMessages.why: ODC: an app (CrossDevice) does not expose a public server action (the live Studio gives an error); the action stays private and without a consumer in this proof job

ops._why: the {CEP} of the URLPath is only substituted if the input is placed in the URL; without this the method compiles but calls the wrong endpoint
